effects: No asset of the signer moves: burn() reads address(this).balance of the message passer and destroys it via Burn.eth (self-destructing helper contract); anyone can call it and the signer only pays gas.
formats.shown: Intent 'Burn withdrawn ETH' / 'Burn ETH left by withdrawals' with no fields.

findings.title: burn(): screen does not say the burned ETH is the contract's balance, not the signer's
findings.evidence: L2ToL1MessagePasser.sol burn(): `uint256 balance = address(this).balance; Burn.eth(balance);`. Descriptor interpolatedIntent 'Burn ETH left by withdrawals'. Case 0 reader.unsure: 'Whose ETH is burned... Whether any of my own ETH or tokens are sent.' Mined case 0: 404086 ETH moved only between the contract and the burn helper, signer null.
findings.fix: Intent e.g. 'Burn ETH held by the withdrawal contract (none of yours)'.

cases.notes: Mined: ETH moves from 0x4200..16 to the burn helper, which self-destructs. signer null, signerNet empty. Screen is accurate. The reader was unsure whose ETH is burned but did not believe their own ETH leaves.

effects: The signer sends msg.value ETH to the L2ToL1MessagePasser on Base; it stays there until burn() is called.

Records a withdrawal message (sentMessages[hash]=true) with sender = signer, target = _target, value = msg.value, gasLimit = _gasLimit, data = _data. After prove and finalize on L1, the OptimismPortal can deliver msg.value ETH to _target on Ethereum and call it with _data. The call comes from the portal, not from the signer's account.
Increments the global message nonce; no approvals or other signer rights change.
formats.shown: Intent 'Start withdrawal of {value} to {_target} on Ethereum', with fields for the ETH sent, the L1 recipient, the min L1 gas and the L1 call, decoded as nested calldata on chain 1 with the portal as sender.

findings.title: initiateWithdrawal: intent says 'ETH withdrawal' but omits the L1 call and that the portal sends it
findings.evidence: Descriptor intent 'Start ETH withdrawal to Ethereum', interpolatedIntent 'Start withdrawal of {@.value} to {_target} on Ethereum'; the call in _data is only in the 'L1 Call' field. Code: initiateWithdrawal hashes data:_data into the message. Case 2 (0 ETH, DAI transfer call) reader.unsure: 'The screen doesn't say who the call is sent from'. Case 4 (0 ETH, message to the L1 messenger) reader: 'Why a 0 ETH withdrawal goes to the L1 messenger'.
findings.fix: Use an intent like 'Send {@.value} and a message to {_target} on Ethereum', and relabel the field 'L1 Call (sent by Base portal)'.

findings.title: initiateWithdrawal: L1 call shows as raw hex when no nested descriptor resolves
findings.evidence: Case 1 'L1 Call' = '0x24eb6264...' and case 2 'L1 Call' = '0xa9059cbb...' are shown raw. Case 1 reader: 'I can't read it'. The call runs from OptimismPortal 0x4904...E97e (the descriptor's spender), so it cannot move the signer's assets directly.
findings.fix: Nothing to change in this descriptor. It needs registry descriptors for the L1 callee contracts.

findings.title: initiateWithdrawal: Min L1 Gas renders as '600000gas' without a space or thousands separator
findings.evidence: Case 1 field 'Min L1 Gas' = '600000gas'; descriptor format 'unit' with base 'gas'.
findings.fix: Rendering detail; the runner could add a space. Optionally use the label 'Min L1 Gas Limit'.
